name: Switchblade 600

placement_rationale.text: 6 km is the anti-armor Switchblade 600's launch/control depth, not a stated flight range — like the 300 variant, no numeric range is recorded here, only that it has 'longer range/endurance than the 300.' Placed one notch past the 300's 5 km, at the edge of doctrine.md §2's close-reconnaissance band and inside the wider 0–10 km FPV-strike-range band, this is consistent with a slightly larger, company- rather than squad-level anti-armor system needing more room to launch and man-in-the-loop control the strike than the man-portable 300. (Nudged 6→6.5 km from this category's shared round-number value so it doesn't literally coincide with side_a-uav-bayraktar-tb2, side_a-uav-punisher on the map's distance axis — a small, deterministic spread within the same band, not a new plausibility claim beyond what's already argued above.)

characteristics: Anti-armor warhead (shaped charge), longer range/endurance than Switchblade 300, man-in-the-loop targeting
Strength: Purpose-built anti-armor capability at the loitering-munition scale, filling a niche between man-portable ATGMs and larger strike UAVs
Limitation: Larger and heavier than the 300 variant, reducing man-portability
Estimated quantity available: Delivered numbers not fully disclosed
employment_notes: Donated specifically to give infantry-scale anti-armor precision strike, functionally similar in role to Russia's Lancet
contrast_vs_traditional: The 600's anti-armor warhead extends the same squad-level distributed-kill-chain logic as the 300 to a target class — tanks and hardened vehicles — that traditional doctrine held was an anti-tank-guided-missile or close-air-support job. A loitering munition doing that from an infantry-level launch point compresses that chain to the same single-digit-minute timeline doctrine.md describes for the rest of the drone-mediated kill chain.

notes: Rests only on tertiary reference works; wants a primary or trade source.

altitude_band_m.note: Class-typical vehicle-launched loitering-munition band. No published operating altitude for this airframe was confirmed.
